candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Analytics Engineer, Marketing Data Warehouse

## Experience

- Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name.
- Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding.
- Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution.
- Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine.
- Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each model in its documentation page.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two merge requests with review records, the onboarding attendance log with the analysts' first contributions, one week's data quality failure log and one release checklist with its approval, with the repository references as a verification trail.
